whenToUse: Deleting an account and its data.
Something is lost, such as reward points.
It can be undone within a set period.
whenNotToUse: You'd make canceling deliberately hard (see the roach motel dark pattern).
You'd block it by making the reason required.
Offering only deletion to people who just want a break.

alternatives.name: Roach Motel
alternatives.reason: The dark pattern of making cancellation hard.

alternatives.name: Confirmation Dialog
alternatives.reason: A light confirmation that can be undone.

accessibility: The button stays disabled until the confirmation text is typed.
What disappears is read as a list.
The request result is read with role="status".
